title: Application of Blackstone Gas Company for approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy for a waiver from the requirements in 49 C.F.R. Part 192, for underground installation of plastic pipe for a bridge crossing to be located in the Town of Blackstone, Massachusetts.
filings: ORDER- Issued by the Commissioners James Connelly, Chairman, Keating, Vasington, Sullivan, Manning. DTE 00-29-A

Petition of Blackstone Gas Company for a waiver from compliance with the burial requirements of 49 CFR 192.321(a) to allow the installation of plastic pipes across a bridge. By Stephen R. Jolicoeur. DTE 00-29-A
